origin: Built by Muse (AI assistant) on 18 November 2026 at Steven Powell's request for a chemistry room, 'Everyday Chemistry': a visual Bohr-model atom bench for 30 elements with plain-language counts, a numbers bench (step-by-step neutron calculator, a formula bench that counts atoms and computes molar mass with the arithmetic shown, and a combinations bench of eight familiar substances), a kitchen shelf of eight safe experiments each tied to an atom/molecule idea, a verified five-link shelf (PhET Build an Atom, RSC periodic table, Ptable, Khan Academy, ACS), a plain-language workshop on atoms/isotopes/formulas/the mole/conservation, and a Help menu with full documentation. Element data are CIAAW standard atomic weights and textbook Bohr shell counts. No upstream original exists; the collection copy is the maintained original.
